sections.title: Feature Engineering
sections.description: This course provides fundamental techniques for extracting, processing, and transforming complex data into formats ready for use within machine learning (ML) models. The course is designed to equip students to understand the underlying principles and practical implementation of these techniques using standard Python packages. Prerequisite: Prior experience with either statistics or computer science. Basic Python programming language skill is required.
